phase: Phase R1 Task 1 — source-scoped concurrency independent rereview
summary: The audited commit is the single direct descendant of the supplied baseline, keeps Task 1 in progress, scopes ordinary staged/status evidence to scanner paths, records an ancestor-checked HEAD interval, rejects regular changed-and-restored scanner commits and non-ancestor history, produces deterministic artifacts in the covered cases, and preserves the existing dirty worktree and index while both 56-test unittest modules pass. Acceptance is still blocked because dependency-aware scanner scoping is incomplete: staged renames and deleted nonstandard tsconfig-extends inputs disappear from the denominator and state evidence, while symlink handling both captures unrelated documentation symlinks and permits changed-and-restored commits to a scanner symlink's physical target.
blocking_findings: [high][R1-SCOPED-H1] Valid scanner-input deletion events disappear from the scoped denominator and Git-state evidence. The filename-only deletion filter at measure/business_operations_graph_baseline_snapshot.py:641-648 drops a staged or unstaged config/base.json deletion when tsconfig.json extends that nonstandard filename; _git_deleted_tracked_paths at lines 203-210 also drops the source side of staged src/app.ts -> docs/app.md because it accepts only D, not R. Independent probes emitted no tombstone and empty status for all three cases. Exact remediation: make deletion discovery dependency-aware by syntactically resolving surviving tsconfig extends references, including deleted nonstandard/workspace-export targets; parse rename records without flattening old/new identity and retain scanner-input rename sources; include every resulting tombstone in pre/post scannerPaths and staged/status evidence; add staged/unstaged deleted-extends and scanner-to-documentation rename adversarial tests asserting tombstone, status, staged diff where applicable, replay, and index preservation; rerun both unittest modules and obtain a fresh independent rereview.

[high][R1-SCOPED-H2] Symlink scope is overbroad and scanner symlink target drift evades the commit interval guard. measure/business_operations_graph_baseline_snapshot.py:612-619 adds every file symlink before applying _is_scanner_input, while lines 1265-1268 and 1310-1317 omit each scanner symlink's resolvedTargetPath from state and intervening-commit scope. Independent probes reported NON_SCANNER_SYMLINK_INCLUDED True and accepted changed-and-restored commits to shared/source.txt supplying src/alias.ts scanner bytes. Exact remediation: filter symlinks with the regular scanner predicate except explicitly resolved extends dependencies; define and artifact-bind dependency scope as manifest scanner paths plus every physical resolvedTargetPath supplying scanner bytes; use it for status, staged diff, and all intervening commit checks; add tests proving unrelated Markdown symlinks are excluded, staged target drift with restored live bytes aborts, and changed-and-restored commits to a non-TypeScript target of a TypeScript symlink abort; rerun both unittest modules and obtain a fresh independent rereview.
nonblocking_findings: [medium][R1-SCOPED-M1] verify_snapshot uses `[0-9a-f]{40,64}` at measure/business_operations_graph_baseline_snapshot.py:1656-1659 and therefore accepts impossible 41- through 63-character object IDs. Validate exactly 40 or exactly 64 lowercase hex characters and add manifest/scan-record tampering tests for 41- and 63-character values.

test_strategy_violations: The focused suite has no deleted nonstandard tsconfig-extends target or staged scanner-to-documentation rename adversary, allowing an incomplete scanner tombstone denominator to remain Green.

The focused suite tests a TypeScript symlink but does not test exclusion of unrelated symlinks or changed-and-restored/staged drift at the symlink's physical target, allowing both over-scoping and a commit-interval bypass.
live_contract_violations: FR2.2 and FR2.4 are violated when a deleted tsconfig-extends dependency or staged rename source disappears from the scanner-input denominator and scoped Git-state evidence.

FR2.4 is violated when changed-and-restored commits to bytes supplied through a TypeScript symlink evade _committed_scanner_drift, while non-scanner documentation symlinks remain incorrectly in scope.
